Class RouxEngine

java.lang.Object
org.roux.RouxEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
MemoryInspector, MemoryLayoutManager, MemoryLifecycleManager, MemoryStateController
@Component public class RouxEngine extends Object implements MemoryInspector, MemoryLayoutManager, MemoryStateController, MemoryLifecycleManager
Roux is the paged memory beside the terminal. The RouxEngine type is that memory. One region is stored for each conversation id. The type implements MemoryInspector, MemoryLayoutManager, MemoryStateController, and MemoryLifecycleManager. A region holds the hot page, the off-heap index, and the map from a RouxId to a message id. The hot page receives writes. A disk region publishes through RegionPack. A memory-only region stays mapped and does not take a pack lock. A caller opens a region, appends a message, reads a window, and closes the region. The type refuses an empty conversation id. The type refuses a snapshot, a heap dump, and defragment in this version.

clayl (2026-08-25)

    • openRam

      public OpenResult openRam(String regionId)
      The method opens a memory-only region. A null id or an empty id returns a refused OpenResult with invalid region. The id is added to the memory-only set before the region is created. An id that is already open returns a new-kind result for that region's UUID. A new id is allocated with a capacity hint of 0. A missing region after that allocation returns a refused result with region not found. The result kind is new for both a fresh id and an id that was already open. The method does not take a pack lock and does not create a spill directory.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id to open.
      Returns:
      The result is a new-kind open, or a refusal.

    • appendMessage

      public OperationResult appendMessage(String regionId, byte role, long timestampEpochMs, int tokenCount, String text)
      The method appends one message frame on the hot page. The region is allocated first, and the capacity hint is 0. A missing region returns OperationStatus.NOT_FOUND and region not found. The payload is encoded by ToonCodec. A frame larger than maxFrameBytes() returns OperationStatus.CORRUPTED_SEGMENT and frame larger than max-frame-bytes. A new RouxId is minted for the message. The wait for the region lock is added to the lock-wait counter. A hot page that cannot hold the frame is rotated first. A failed rotation is returned as that failure. A page that is still too small returns OperationStatus.CORRUPTED_SEGMENT and hot page too small. The frame type is FrameType.MSG. The message id is the region's next id, and that id then advances by one. The first frame on a page stores the first message id. The last message id on the page becomes this message id. The index row and the identity map both record the new id. The appended-frame counter and the index-entry counter each advance by one. Durability append with an enabled pack publishes the hot page. The page pin is released before the method returns. Success uses an empty message.
      Specified by:
      appendMessage in interface MemoryStateController
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      role - The role is the role byte stored in the frame.
      timestampEpochMs - The time is the epoch milliseconds stored in the frame.
      tokenCount - The token count is the number stored in the frame.
      text - The text is the message body.
      Returns:
      The result is success, or the failure from allocation, size, or rotation.

    • clearRegion

      public void clearRegion(String regionId)
      The method drops the frames and keeps the region. A missing region returns without a change. The pages are closed, the index is reset, and the identity map is cleared. The next message id becomes 1. A new hot page 0 is stored, and the next page id becomes 1. The allocated-page counter increments. A memory-only process recounts the used bytes and returns. Any other process wipes the pack, writes the manifest, and then recounts.
      Specified by:
      clearRegion in interface MemoryStateController
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.

    • tryAcquireLock

      public LockToken tryAcquireLock(String regionId, int level, long timeoutMs)
      The method tries to take the region lock. A missing region returns null. The wait is timeoutMs milliseconds. A timeout returns null. An interrupt returns null and sets the interrupt status on this thread. The token id is a random UUID string. The level is stored on the token and does not change the branch. The token is stored as the operator lock. The region lock stays held until releaseLock(LockToken).
      Specified by:
      tryAcquireLock in interface MemoryStateController
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      level - The level is stored on the token.
      timeoutMs - The timeout is the wait in milliseconds.
      Returns:
      The token is the held lock, or null when the lock was not taken.

      public void readRaw(MemoryAddress address, MemorySegment dest)
      The method copies bytes from a mapped page into a destination. A null address or a null destination returns without a copy. A missing region returns without a copy.     • openRegion

      public OpenResult openRegion(String regionId)
      The method opens a region or restores one from the pack. A null id or an empty id is refused with invalid username. A memory-only process allocates the id and returns a new-kind result. A missing region after that allocation is refused with region not found. An id that is already in the region map is refused with session already open for plus the id. A pack lock that is not acquired uses that same refusal. A new region keeps the pack lock. No pack file and no manifest file allocates the id and returns a new-kind result. A failed allocation unlocks the pack and is refused with region not found. Restore turned off unlocks the pack. The refusal is roux restore disabled; leftover pack not attached; delete plus the directory plus or enable restore. A manifest file without a pack file uses the incomplete-pack refusal. That refusal is roux pack incomplete or corrupt; delete plus the directory plus or revert yaml. A manifest that cannot be read, a null manifest, a format version other than PageHeader.VERSION, or an owner that is not empty and not this id uses that same refusal. A page size that differs from pageBytes() is refused with roux pack page-bytes mismatch (manifest plus the manifest size plus , yaml plus the engine size plus ). A pack with no manifest is restored by restoreFromPack(String, RegionManifest) with a null manifest. A matching pack and manifest is restored with that manifest. A refused restore unlocks the pack. // @aa-sdd PK-1401 docs/specs/java/org/roux/roux.spec.md
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      Returns:
      The result is new, restored, or refused.

    • persistClose

      public OperationResult persistClose(String regionId)
      The method closes one region. A missing region returns success with already closed. A region that is already closed returns that same success. A memory-only process, or an id opened through openRam(String), destroys the region and removes the id. That path returns success with closed. Persist on publishes the hot page, writes the manifest, saves the head prefix, destroys the region, and unlocks the pack. The files stay. Persist off destroys the region and deletes the region directory. Both disk paths mark the region closed, remove the id, and return success with closed.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      Returns:
      The result is success with already closed or closed.

Missing bytes, or a frame shorter than the header, return null. A checksum mismatch increments the dirty-frame counter and returns null. A match is decoded by ToonCodec.

    • windowIds

      public long[] windowIds(String regionId, int maxNonSystem, boolean pinSystem, int maxTokens)
      The method returns message ids for one window. A missing region returns a zero-length array. An empty index returns a zero-length array. The order is the pinned system ids, then the tail in ascending id order. A true pin flag uses pinnedSystemIds(RouxEngine.Region). A false pin flag pins nothing. Pinned token counts are charged first. A pinned id is left out of the tail. A row that is missing or is not FrameType.MSG is skipped. An assistant row takes the previous row when that id is not pinned and its role is Role.USER, Role.TOOL, or Role.TOOL_CALL. A maxNonSystem of zero or less means no message cap. A maxTokens of zero or less means no token cap. The first tail atom is kept even when it passes a cap. A later atom that would pass the message cap is left out, and the scan stops. A later atom that would pass the token cap is kept, and the scan then stops.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      maxNonSystem - The cap is the non-system message limit, and zero or less means no message cap.
      pinSystem - The flag includes the system pin when it is true.
      maxTokens - The budget is the token limit, and zero or less means no token cap.
      Returns:
      The ids are the pinned ids followed by the ascending tail.

      Parameters:

      public void checkpoint(String regionId)

A missing region returns without a write. Any other region publishes through checkpointHot(RouxEngine.Region) while the region lock is held. The page stays mapped.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.

      public MessageInspect inspect(String regionId, long seq)
      The method inspects one index row. A missing region returns null. A missing index row returns null. The residency is taken from the page before the bytes are read. A missing page is recorded as SPILLED. The text is filled only when the checksum matches and ToonCodec.decode(byte[], long, byte, long, int) returns a frame. A short frame leaves the text empty and the checksum flag false.

      Returns:

      public String memoryStatusLine(String regionId)
      The method returns one status line. A missing region returns pages=0. The line is pages= the page count, hot= the hot page id or -1, spilled= the spilled count, resident= the mapped count, durability= the normalized durability, and seq= the index size. A spilled page is spilled and has no segment. A resident page has a segment.

      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      Returns:
      The line is the status text.

    • selectCut

      public static RouxEngine.SinkCut selectCut(int managedTokens, long[] seqs, byte[] roles, int[] tokens, boolean[] heads, boolean[] stays, boolean[] lives)
      The method selects pieces and returns their ordinals. A null seq array, role array, or token array returns null. Arrays of different lengths return null. A missing or shorter head, stay, or live array reads the missing flags as false. Each ordinal is the index in those arrays. A null transcript from ReichenbachSink.select(int, ReichenbachSink.Piece[]) returns null. The ordinals are copied from the transcript pieces.
      Parameters:
      managedTokens - The allowance is the token limit passed to the selector.
      seqs - The seqs are the message ids, and 0 is the live line.
      roles - The roles are the role bytes.
      tokens - The tokens are the token counts.
      heads - The heads mark the packed head, or null.
      stays - The stays mark pieces that join the pin, or null.
      lives - The lives mark the live line, or null.
      Returns:
      The cut is the selection, or null when the selection is refused.

    • selectTape

      public RouxEngine.SinkCut selectTape(String regionId, int managedTokens, int liveTokens)
      The method selects the stored messages plus one optional live line. A missing region returns null. An allowance of zero or less returns null. A null or empty head prefix returns null. Only FrameType.MSG rows are included. A negative live token count adds no live line. Any other live token count adds a piece with message id 0, role Role.USER, and the live flag set. That live line is not stored in the region. The stay flags are passed as null. A head flag is true when the message id is in the stored head prefix.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      managedTokens - The allowance is the token limit.
      liveTokens - The live count is the unsent line, and a negative count means there is no live line.
      Returns:
      The cut is the selection, or null when the selection is refused.

    • messageSeqAt

      public long messageSeqAt(String regionId, int ordinal)
      The method returns the message id at a stored ordinal. A missing region returns 0. An ordinal below zero returns 0. Only FrameType.MSG rows are counted. Ordinal 0 is the first stored message. An ordinal past the last stored message returns 0.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      ordinal - The ordinal is the zero-based count of stored messages.
      Returns:
      The id is the stored message id, or 0 when the ordinal does not name one.

    • headDesignated

      public boolean headDesignated(String regionId)
      The method reports whether a head prefix is stored. A missing region returns false. A null prefix or an empty prefix returns false.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      Returns:
      The flag is true when at least one head message id is stored.

    • applyHeadCount

      public void applyHeadCount(String regionId, int count)
      The method stores a head count and trims a prefix that no longer matches. A missing region returns without a change. A negative count is stored as 0. The eligible ids are the first non-system messages up to that count. A stored prefix that already matches the start of those ids is left unchanged. That path does not write the head file. Any other prefix is cut to the matching start and saved. The method does not add ids when the count grows. A shorter eligible run trims the prefix.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      count - The count is the requested head length.

    • headMark

      public String headMark(String regionId, long seq)
      The method returns the lock mark for one message id. A missing region returns an empty string. An id in the stored head prefix returns locked, including the leading space. An id in the eligible run returns may lock, including the leading space. Every other id returns an empty string.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      seq - The seq is the stored message id.
      Returns:
      The mark is locked, may lock, or an empty string.

    • lockMessage

      public String lockMessage(String regionId, long seq)
      The method appends one message id to the head prefix. A missing region returns No message seq plus the id. prefixMiss(RouxEngine.Region, long, boolean) supplies any other refusal. Success appends the id, saves the head prefix, and returns null.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      seq - The seq is the message id to lock.
      Returns:
      The text is null when the prefix grew, or one refusal sentence.

    • unlockMessage

      public String unlockMessage(String regionId, long seq)
      The method drops the last id in the head prefix. A missing region returns No message seq plus the id. prefixMiss(RouxEngine.Region, long, boolean) supplies any other refusal. Success removes that last id, saves the head prefix, and returns null.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      seq - The seq is the message id to unlock.
      Returns:
      The text is null when the prefix shrank, or one refusal sentence.

    • editMessage

      public OperationResult editMessage(String regionId, long seq, String text)
      The method appends a new frame for an existing message id. A null body or an empty body returns OperationStatus.NOT_FOUND and An empty body is refused. A missing region, or a row that is missing or is not FrameType.MSG, returns OperationStatus.NOT_FOUND and No message seq plus the id. The token count comes from a new HeuristicTokenCounter. The payload keeps the stored role, the stored time, and the stored RouxId. A frame larger than maxFrameBytes() returns OperationStatus.CORRUPTED_SEGMENT and frame larger than max-frame-bytes. A hot page that cannot hold the frame is rotated first. A failed rotation is returned as that failure. A page that is still too small returns OperationStatus.CORRUPTED_SEGMENT and hot page too small. The new frame uses the same message id. The last id on the page changes only when this id is greater than or equal to the current last id. The index row is retargeted to the new page, offset, length, and token count. The identity map is not changed. The prior bytes are not erased. The head prefix is not changed. The appended-frame counter advances by one. Durability append with an enabled pack publishes the hot page. Success uses an empty message.
      Parameters:
      regionId - The region id is the conversation id.
      seq - The seq is the stored message id.
      text - The text is the new body.
      Returns:
      The result is success, or the empty-body, missing, size, or rotation failure.
